content.user_title: Plan Token Budgets Before Large AI Tasks
content.value_statement: Large AI tasks can exceed context limits before the work is complete. This skill estimates token usage, splits work into chunks, and creates checkpointed plans for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Calculates remaining token budget with a configurable safety buffer.
Estimates task complexity from task type, integrations, testing, documentation, and agent needs.
Splits oversized work into sequential chunks with dependencies and expected outputs.
Ranks chunks by priority, critical path value, risk, and quick-win potential.
Creates execution plans with checkpoints, budget tracking, and contingency steps.
Provides examples for pre-task checks, mid-task monitoring, and post-task review.
limitations: Token estimates are planning aids and may differ from actual model usage.
The skill does not read live token counters unless the host environment provides them.
Example hook commands require the separate claude-flow package and user approval.
It does not execute project work; it prepares the plan for another agent or user.

use_cases.title: Plan a Large Feature Build
use_cases.description: Estimate the token cost of a multi-step feature and split it into manageable chunks before implementation starts.

use_cases.title: Recover From Token Exhaustion
use_cases.description: Replan unfinished work after a session exceeds budget, using checkpoints and deferred tasks.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Multi-Agent Work
use_cases.description: Assign budgets, dependencies, and success criteria across planner, coding, testing, and documentation agents.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Budget Check
prompt_templates.scenario: You know the task and current token usage.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to assess whether my task fits the token budget. Task: [describe task]. Token limit: [limit]. Current usage: [used]. Return a simple budget status and recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Chunk a Large Task
prompt_templates.scenario: The task may not fit in one session.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to estimate token usage and split this task into chunks: [describe task]. Include dependencies, expected outputs, estimated tokens, and stop points for each chunk.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize Under Constraint
prompt_templates.scenario: Budget is tight and some work can be deferred.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a budget-aware priority plan. Available tokens: [available]. Required work: [list]. Optional work: [list]. Show what to do now, defer, or reduce.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multi-Agent Execution
prompt_templates.scenario: Several agents or roles will work on one project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a multi-agent execution plan for [project]. Estimate token use per agent, define chunk boundaries, checkpoint data, handoff notes, and contingency actions.

output_examples.input: Build an authentication system with 155,000 tokens remaining.
output_examples.output: Budget status is healthy. The skill estimates about 39,000 tokens, recommends four chunks, and keeps a large safety margin.

output_examples.input: Refactor a legacy module with only 30,000 tokens available.
output_examples.output: The plan prioritizes analysis and the core refactor first, defers documentation polish, and adds checkpoints after each safe stopping point.

output_examples.input: Coordinate frontend, backend, tests, and documentation agents.
output_examples.output: The skill assigns budgets to each role, orders dependencies, defines handoff outputs, and reserves a buffer for integration fixes.

best_practices: Run the skill before large tasks or when current usage exceeds half of the limit.
Keep a safety buffer and update estimates after every checkpoint.
Record actual usage so future plans become more accurate.
anti_patterns: Starting a large task without estimating the available token budget.
Creating chunks that depend on hidden state from earlier sessions.
Treating estimated token counts as exact guarantees.

faq.question: Does this skill reduce token usage automatically?
faq.answer: No. It helps plan and prioritize work so the user can avoid unnecessary token use.

faq.question: Can it read my live token usage?
faq.answer: Only if the host environment exposes token data or the user provides current usage.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it before complex tasks, multi-agent work, or any session that may approach token limits.

faq.question: Does it execute the plan?
faq.answer: No. It creates an execution plan with estimates, checkpoints, and contingency guidance.

faq.question: Why does it include command examples?
faq.answer: Some examples show optional claude-flow hooks for tracking progress. Users should approve and pin any external tool before running it.
